articles.title: Burnham orders review of grooming gang early releases
articles.description: The announcement of the review comes after the Tory leader raised concerns that child sex offenders could leave jail early.

articles.title: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
articles.description: Fifa's backing of president Gianni Infantino at a meeting on Wednesday "changes nothing", says European governing body Uefa.

articles.title: Calls for inquiry into Army training college for teenagers after reports of rape and abuse
articles.description: Four women told the BBC they were sexually assaulted and harassed while attending the Army Foundation College (AFC) at Harrogate in North Yorkshire.

articles.title: Stephen Bear jailed for breaching restraining order
articles.description: The reality TV contestant is back in prison after admitting a harassment charge regarding Georgia Harrison.
